verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's own API documents programmatic management of triggers and SLOs, which covers alerts-as-code through the API, and it offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for tooling. The evidence never shows Boards (dashboards) being managed through the API (only "and more"), and nothing mentions Terraform or JSON dashboard models. missing for 10: documented API or JSON model for Boards/dashboards, Terraform provider, evidence of a repeatable provisioning workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably

citations.quote: Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.
